verses.1: And they assembled on the occasion of their resurrection in the name of the one new congregation, both the company of the fellowship of the ten; and they were gathered from the assembly of their resurrection from their death, even as we are gathered in the month in Zion, like the going forth of the feast in the name of the upper room. Thomas spoke after him; the place of the congregation from their gathering to our Lord Christ, and the place of the congregation until the day of the appointed time of the seventh day. And they were gathered, saying, 'Our God and our life,' and he said, and he breathed on Thomas, and he became a believer.
